newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest high-caps down, smaller stocks in focus.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest high-caps down, smaller stocks in focus.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse saw a weeks-long pattern reversed on Tuesday when most first-tier shares fell as a bearish mood crept into the section and investors showed interest in smaller capitalisation stocks.

Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, slumped from the previous session due to the sharp falls in some of the high-caps. VAB and CAS-SE slipped 10.45 percent and BIG was 9.91 percent down.
"Supply of most heavyweights was strong today and we no longer had the buy notes for large packages we used to have in previous sessions," a trader said.
"Foreigners as well as local investors were no longer willing to buy high-caps at their recent expensive prices," another trader added. "Instead, they started buying cheaper smaller caps."
Volume rose to 3.9 million shares from 3.7 million and turnover added 1.4 billion lei to 19.4 billion.
There was one separate special trade in Carbid-Fox carbide maker, which involved 571,984 shares traded at 7,450 lei per share. Carbid closed at 7,000, 150 lei up.
Sofert SOFE.BX fertiliser maker was the only first-tier gainer. It closed 1,200 lei stronger at 38,200 in thin late trading supply.
Twenty-one of 38 stocks in the lower section saw rises in their average prices and most of them closed higher as supply thinned and buying pressure built up in late trading.
Armatura industrial fittings maker took the bulk of volume in this section and had 1.2 billion lei in turnover. It firmer 100 lei to close at 7,750.
